blocks.heading: Semiconductor Manufacturing (Samsung Austin)
paragraphs: Samsung Semiconductor Austin's $17B investment in the Taylor, TX fab (adjacent Austin metro) is the largest semiconductor manufacturing investment in Texas history:
Wafer inspection CV at advanced process nodes for Samsung's Austin operations.
Yield prediction from process parameter data and equipment telemetry.
Fab equipment predictive maintenance from sensor data.
Supply chain analytics for Samsung's Austin-area component supplier ecosystem.
Cost: $60,000–$170,000 | Timeline: 14–28 weeks

blocks.heading: Autonomous Vehicles and Robotics (Tesla Ecosystem)
paragraphs: Tesla's Gigafactory Texas (Austin) is one of the world's largest EV manufacturing facilities — and its presence has attracted suppliers, technology companies, and talent that create AI demand:
Manufacturing quality AI for Tesla's supplier ecosystem — vision inspection for automotive components.
Autonomous driving adjacent AI — commercial applications for Austin's mobility technology companies.
Robotics manufacturing AI for Austin's robotics startups adjacent to Tesla.
Cost: $55,000–$160,000 | Timeline: 14–26 weeks

blocks.heading: Enterprise Technology (The California Migration)
paragraphs: Oracle (Austin campus, relocated from Redwood Shores), HP Inc./HPE (Austin campus), Apple (6,500 employee campus), and hundreds of California tech companies with Austin engineering offices:
Enterprise analytics AI for Oracle's large cloud and database customer base.
Product ML for Austin's growing enterprise SaaS community — founded by California technology professionals who relocated to Austin.

Cost: $35,000–$120,000 | Timeline: 10–22 weeks

blocks.heading: SaaS and Digital Technology

sections.title: Austin AI Market Context
sections.description: Key considerations for AI development in Austin.

blocks.heading: Texas's no-income-tax advantage
paragraphs: Texas's zero state income tax has been a major driver of the California technology migration — creating a cost-competitive technology talent market in Austin that draws California AI engineers and their companies.

blocks.heading: UT Austin's engineering programs
paragraphs: UT Austin's Cockrell School of Engineering and its expanding data science and AI programs are increasingly producing AI talent that stays in Austin rather than relocating, creating organic talent growth.

blocks.heading: Emerging technology culture
paragraphs: Austin's 'Keep Austin Weird' culture has evolved into 'Keep Austin Innovative' — the SXSW tech conference, Austin Forum on Technology and Society, and the general entrepreneurial culture create an AI innovation context that attracts investment and experimentation.
